The quantifier, measure and part-whole ' of' does not fire it (59 'number of' occurrences peak at 0.20, 32 'amount of' at 0.44, 'majority of', 'part of', 'size of', 'weight of', 'door of', 'theory of' all stay at the -0.17 floor), the complement after ' of' cannot affect it because the pole is computed before that token is read, and the one leftover it does not explain is the bare capital-letter fragment 'C' heading a capitalised word or acronym (CPR, CFA).
